newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 261 OF OCTOBER 15, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 261 OF OCTOBER 15, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 30 September 1996 amending Commission Decision 93/402/EEC concerning animal health conditions and veterinary certification for imports of fresh meat from South American Countries (Text with EEA relevance)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1972/96 of 14 October 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1971/96 of 14 October 1996 reducing the basic and buying-in prices for oranges, mandarins and clementines for the 1996/97 marketing year as a result of the overrun in the intervention threshold for 1995/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1970/96 of 14 October 1996 opening and laying down detailed rules for the management of a Community tariff quota for millet falling within CN code 1008 20 00
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1969/96 of 14 October 1996 on the supply of vegetable oil as food aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1968/96 of 14 October 1996 fixing the yields in olives and olive oils for the 1995/96 marketing year

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1967/96 of 9 October 1996 determining the amounts of the agricultural components and the additional duties applicable from 1 July to 31 December 1996 in the importation into the Community of goods covered by Council Regulation (EC) No 3448/93 from Switzerland END OF DOCUMENT.
